ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The feasible region is determined by x≥0, y≥0, x+2y≤4, and is triangle T, with vertices (0,0), (4,0), (0,2). Regard z=(y+2)/(x-1) as the slope of the line joining point P=(1,-2) and the feasible point (x,y), because this slope is (y-(-2))/(x-1). When x=1, the denominator is 0, and z is undefined; and y+2>0. If x<1, then the slope is negative. At this time, drawing rays from P toward the left part of the triangle, the maximum negative slope (closest to 0) appears at vertex (0,0), and is (0+2)/(0-1)=-2; when the feasible point approaches the left side of x=1, the denominator tends to 0^-, and the slope tends to -∞, so the range of negative values is (-∞,-2]. If x>1, then the slope is positive. At this time, drawing rays from P toward the right part of the triangle, the minimum positive slope appears at vertex (4,0), and is (0+2)/(4-1)=2/3; when the feasible point approaches the right side of x=1, the denominator tends to 0^+, and the slope tends to +∞, so the range of positive values is [2/3,+∞). Combining the two parts, the range of values of z is (-∞,-2] ∪ [2/3,+∞).

raw_record.question_text: If the real numbers $x 、 y$ satisfy $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x+2 y-4 \leq 0, \\ x \geq 0, \\ y \geq 0,\end{array}\right.$, then the range of values of $z=\frac{y+2}{x-1}$ is ( )

method.method_draft: 几何斜率法：先从题面读出可行域为三角形区域 T：x≥0，y≥0，x+2y≤4，顶点为 (0,0)、(4,0)、(0,2)。把 z=(y+2)/(x-1) 看成点 P=(1,-2) 与可行点 (x,y) 连线的斜率。由于 x=1 时分母为 0，且 y+2>0，所以 x<1 时斜率为负，x>1 时斜率为正。考察从 P 发出的射线与三角形 T 相交时的斜率范围：负斜率部分在 x<1 一侧，最大负斜率由射到 (0,0) 给出，为 -2，而当可行点趋近于 x=1 左侧且 y≥0 时斜率趋于 -∞，所以负值范围为 (-∞,-2]。正斜率部分在 x>1 一侧，最小正斜率由射到 (4,0) 给出，为 2/3，而当可行点趋近于 x=1 右侧且 y≥0 时斜率趋于 +∞，所以正值范围为 [2/3,+∞)。合并得到 (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞)。

method.method_draft: 代数分支与构造法：由约束得 0≤x≤4，0≤y≤(4-x)/2，并注意 y+2>0，所以 z 的符号只由 x-1 决定。若 x<1，则 z<0。此时 x-1∈[-1,0)，y+2≥2，分母为负，因此 z=(y+2)/(x-1)≤2/(x-1)≤-2，故所有负值至多为 -2。反过来，对任意 z≤-2，取 y=0，x=1+2/z，则 0≤x<1，且 x+2y≤4，代入得 z=2/(x-1)，所以 (-∞,-2] 全部可取。若 x>1，则 z>0。此时 x≤4，所以 x-1≤3，且 y+2≥2，因此 z=(y+2)/(x-1)≥2/(x-1)≥2/3。反过来，对任意 z≥2/3，取 y=0，x=1+2/z，则 1<x≤4，满足约束并代入得到原 z，所以 [2/3,+∞) 全部可取。x=1 不允许，z=0 也不可能，因此范围为 (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞)。
